result.rationale: ADD_OWNER is a false-positive match: the census and repository describe the same platform, whose existing active MSIP period already captures the only disclosed sponsor. The official announcement was 2025-01-21, not June 2025. KeyBanc identifies platform equity; MSIP's portfolio and later evidence support closed, active ownership. Exact close, stake, control, fund, vehicle, acquisition affiliate, retained founder stake and co-investors are not public. No later platform owner change or exit was found.
